OA-WAM: Object-Addressable World Action Model for Robust Robot Manipulation WorldModel

object-addressable world action model robot manipulation slot states flow-matching

简要说明：OA-WAM提出了一种面向机器人操作的对象可寻址世界行动模型，通过将场景分解为持久的对象槽，提升在场景扰动下的鲁棒性。

TLDR: OA-WAM introduces an object-addressable world action model for robot manipulation that decomposes scenes into persistent object slots to improve robustness under scene shifts.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) enhance Vision-Language-Action policies by jointly predicting scene evolution and robot actions, but existing methods usually represent the predicted world as holistic images, video tokens, or global latents. These representations are difficult for an action decoder to address when an instruction refers to a particular object, especially under scene shifts where object identity is entangled with context. We propose OA-WAM, an Object-Addressable World Action Model for robust robot manipulation. OA-WAM decomposes each frame into N+1 slot states, with one robot slot and N object slots. Each slot contains a persistent address vector and a time-varying content vector, and is fused with text, image, proprioception, and past-action tokens in a block-causal sequence. A world head predicts next-frame slot states, while a flow-matching action head decodes a 16-step continuous action chunk in the same forward pass. Addressability is enforced by routing cross-slot attention through address-only keys and resetting the address slice at every transformer layer, separating which object to act on from what that object currently is without adding extra tokens. OA-WAM matches strong VLA and WAM baselines on LIBERO (97.8%) and SimplerEnv (79.3%), reaches state-of-the-art performance on the most relevant LIBERO-Plus geometric axes, and remains competitive on the seven-axis aggregate. A causal slot-intervention test yields a swap-binding cosine of 0.87, versus at most 0.09 for holistic baselines. These results suggest that addressable object states provide an effective interface for robust world-action modeling under scene perturbations.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）通过联合预测场景演变与机器人动作，增强了视觉-语言-行动策略，但现有方法通常将预测的世界表示为整体图像、视频标记或全局潜在向量。这些表示方式难以被动作解码器处理，尤其是当指令涉及特定物体且在场景变化下物体身份与背景信息相互纠缠时。我们提出了OA-WAM，一种面向鲁棒机器人操作的物体可寻址世界行动模型。OA-WAM将每一帧分解为N+1个槽位状态，包括一个机器人槽位和N个物体槽位。每个槽位包含一个持久性地址向量和一个时变内容向量，并以块因果序列的形式与文本、图像、本体感知及历史动作标记相融合。一个世界预测头负责预测下一帧的槽位状态，同时一个流匹配动作头在同一前向传播过程中解码出16步的连续动作片段。模型通过仅基于地址的键进行跨槽位注意力路由，并在每个Transformer层重置地址切片，从而强制实现可寻址性，使得“操作哪个物体”与“该物体当前状态”相互分离，而无需引入额外标记。OA-WAM在LIBERO数据集上达到97.8%的性能，在SimplerEnv上达到79.3%，与当前先进的视觉-语言-行动及世界行动模型基线持平，并在最相关的LIBERO-Plus几何轴任务上取得最优性能，同时在七轴综合任务中保持竞争力。因果槽位干预测试结果显示，模型交换绑定的余弦相似度达到0.87，而整体表示基线的最高值仅为0.09。这些结果表明，可寻址的物体状态为场景扰动下鲁棒的世界-行动建模提供了有效的接口。

Authors: Yushan Liu, Peibo Sun, Shoujie Li, Yifan Xie, Lingfeng Zhang, Xintao Chao, Shiyuan Dong, Fang Chen, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Wenbo Ding

Reconstruction or Semantics? What Makes a Latent Space Useful for Robotic World Models WorldModel

latent diffusion modeling world models action-conditioned video diffusion robotic control latent representation

简要说明：该论文系统评估了机器人世界模型的潜在空间，发现在策略相关指标上，语义编码器优于以重建为目标的编码器。

TLDR: The paper systematically evaluates latent spaces for robotic world models, finding that semantic encoders outperform reconstruction-focused encoders in policy-relevant metrics.

Abstract: World model-based policy evaluation is a practical proxy for testing real-world robot control by rolling out candidate actions in action-conditioned video diffusion models. As these models increasingly adopt latent diffusion modeling (LDM), choosing the right latent space becomes critical. While the status quo uses autoencoding latent spaces like VAEs that are primarily trained for pixel reconstruction, recent work suggests benefits from pretrained encoders with representation-aligned semantic latent spaces. We systematically evaluate these latent spaces for action-conditioned LDM by comparing six reconstruction and semantic encoders to train world model variants under a fixed protocol on BridgeV2 dataset, and show effective world model training in high-dimensional representation spaces with and without dimension compression. We then propose three axes to assess robotic world model performance: visual fidelity, planning and downstream policy performance, and latent representation quality. Our results show visual fidelity alone is insufficient for world model selection. While reconstruction encoders like VAE and Cosmos achieve strong pixel-level scores, semantic encoders such as V-JEPA 2.1 (strongest overall on policy), Web-DINO, and SigLIP 2 generally excel across the other two axes at all model scales. Our study advocates semantic latent space as stronger foundation for policy-relevant robotics diffusion world models.

摘要（中文）：基于世界模型的政策评估是一种实用方法，通过动作条件视频扩散模型推演候选动作来测试真实机器人控制。随着这些模型日益采用潜在扩散模型（LDM），选择合适的潜在空间变得至关重要。虽然现有方法普遍使用以像素重建为主要训练目标的自编码潜在空间（如VAE），但近期研究表明，采用预训练编码器构建表征对齐的语义潜在空间具有优势。我们在BridgeV2数据集上通过固定实验方案，系统评估了六种重建型与语义编码器在动作条件LDM中的表现，训练了多种世界模型变体，并证明在高维表征空间（无论是否进行维度压缩）中均可实现有效的世界模型训练。我们继而提出三个维度评估机器人世界模型性能：视觉保真度、规划与下游策略性能、潜在表征质量。实验表明，仅凭视觉保真度不足以作为世界模型选择标准。虽然VAE和Cosmos等重建编码器在像素级指标上表现优异，但V-JEPA 2.1（策略性能最强）、Web-DINO和SigLIP 2等语义编码器在所有模型规模上均能全面领先于后两个评估维度。本研究主张将语义潜在空间作为政策相关机器人扩散世界模型更优的构建基础。

Authors: Nilaksh, Saurav Jha, Artem Zholus, Sarath Chandar

CKT-WAM: Parameter-Efficient Context Knowledge Transfer Between World Action Models WorldModel

world action models knowledge transfer parameter-efficient long-horizon manipulation context adaptation

简要说明：CKT-WAM是一种参数高效的知识迁移框架，用于在具身控制的世界动作模型之间传递知识，通过文本嵌入空间中的紧凑上下文实现，并在模拟和现实世界的长视野操作任务中表现出色。

TLDR: CKT-WAM is a parameter-efficient framework for transferring knowledge between world action models for embodied control, using a compact context in the text embedding space, and demonstrates strong performance on both simulated and real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) provide a powerful generative framework for embodied control, yet transferring knowledge across heterogeneous WAMs remains challenging due to mismatched latent interfaces, high adaptation cost, and the rigidity of conventional distillation objectives. We propose \textbf{CKT-WAM}, a parameter-efficient \textbf{C}ontext \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{T}ransfer framework that transfers teacher WAM's knowledge into a student WAM through a compact context in the text embedding space, rather than output imitation or dense hidden-state matching. Specifically, CKT-WAM extracts intermediate teacher hidden states, reduces the number of tokens via compressors' learnable-query cross attention (LQCA), and transforms them through an always-on generalized adapter, a lightweight router, and sparsely activated specialized adapters. The resulting context is then appended to the student's conditioning textual embeddings, thereby injecting the transferred knowledge into the student with minimal architectural modification. Experiments show that CKT-WAM consistently improves zero-shot generalization and achieves the best overall performance on LIBERO-Plus, reaching 86.1\% total success rate with only 1.17\% trainable parameters, while approaching full fine-tuning performance. Beyond simulation, CKT-WAM also demonstrates strong real-world long-horizon manipulation ability, achieving the best average success rate of 83.3\% across four multi-step and long-horizon tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/CKT-WAM.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAM）为具身控制提供了强大的生成式框架，但受限于潜在接口不匹配、适应成本高昂以及传统蒸馏目标的僵化性，跨异构WAM的知识迁移仍面临挑战。我们提出 \textbf{CKT-WAM}，一种参数高效的\textbf{上下文知识迁移}框架，通过文本嵌入空间中的紧凑上下文将教师WAM的知识迁移至学生WAM，而非依赖输出模仿或密集隐藏状态匹配。具体而言，CKT-WAM提取教师中间隐藏状态，通过压缩器可学习查询交叉注意力机制（LQCA）减少标记数量，并利用常驻通用适配器、轻量级路由器和稀疏激活的专用适配器进行转换。生成的上下文随后附加至学生条件文本嵌入中，从而以最小的架构改动实现知识注入。实验表明，CKT-WAM在零样本泛化能力上持续提升，在LIBERO-Plus上取得了86.1\%的总成功率（仅需1.17\%可训练参数），接近全微调性能，综合表现最佳。除仿真环境外，CKT-WAM在现实世界长时程操作任务中亦展现强大能力，在四项多步骤长时程任务中达到83.3\%的平均成功率。代码已开源：https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/CKT-WAM。

Authors: Yuhua Jiang, Yijun Guo, Hongbing Yang, Guojun Lei, Nuo Chen, Yinuo Zhang, Shaoqiang Yan, Bo Lin, Feifei Gao, Biqing Qi

VLA-GSE: Boosting Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning in VLA with Generalized and Specialized Experts VLA

VLA parameter-efficient fine-tuning robot control generalized experts specialized experts

简要说明：提出了VLA-GSE，一种用于VLA模型的高效参数微调框架，它将冻结的主干网络参数分解为通用专家和专用专家，在保留预训练视觉语言知识的同时，提升了机器人控制任务的适应能力。

TLDR: Proposes VLA-GSE, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework for VLA models that decomposes frozen backbone parameters into generalized and specialized experts, improving robot control adaptation while preserving pretrained vision-language knowledge.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit rich visual-semantic priors from pre-trained vision-language backbones, but adapting them to robotic control remains challenging. Full fine-tuning (FFT) is prone to overfitting on downstream robotic data and catastrophic forgetting of pretrained vision-language capabilities. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) better preserves pre-trained knowledge, yet existing PEFT methods still struggle to adapt effectively to robot control tasks. To address this gap, we propose VLA-GSE, a parameter-efficient VLA fine-tuning framework that improves control adaptation while retaining PEFT's knowledge preservation advantage. Specifically, VLA-GSE (Generalized and Specialized Experts) is initialized by spectrally decomposing the frozen backbone, assigning leading singular components to generalized experts (shared experts) and disjoint residual components to specialized experts (routed experts). This decomposition improves adaptation capacity under a fixed trainable-parameter budget. Under a comparable parameter budget, VLA-GSE updates only 2.51% of the full model parameters and consistently outperforms strong FFT and PEFT baselines. It achieves 81.2% average zero-shot success on LIBERO-Plus, preserves pre-trained VLM capability comparably to LoRA on multimodal understanding benchmarks, and improves real-world manipulation success under multiple distribution shifts. Code is available at: https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/VLA-GSE

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型继承了预训练视觉-语言骨干网络丰富的视觉语义先验知识，但其在机器人控制任务中的适配仍面临挑战。全参数微调方法易在下游机器人数据上产生过拟合，并导致预训练的视觉-语言能力发生灾难性遗忘。参数高效微调方法虽能更好地保留预训练知识，但现有方案在机器人控制任务的有效适配方面仍存在困难。为解决这一问题，我们提出参数高效的视觉-语言-动作微调框架VLA-GSE，在保持参数高效微调知识保留优势的同时提升控制任务适配能力。该框架通过频谱分解冻结骨干网络进行初始化：将主导奇异分量分配给通用专家，并将互不相交的残差分量分配给专用专家。这种分解方式能在固定可训练参数预算下提升适配能力。在可比参数预算下，VLA-GSE仅更新全模型2.51%的参数，却持续超越全参数微调与参数高效微调的基线方法。在LIBERO-Plus基准测试中实现81.2%的零样本平均成功率，在多模态理解基准测试中保持与LoRA相当的预训练视觉语言模型能力，并在多种分布偏移环境下提升真实世界操作任务的成功率。代码已开源：https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/VLA-GSE

Authors: Yuhua Jiang, Junjie Lu, Xinyao Qin, Xiaoyu Chen, Kaixin Wang, Feifei Gao, Li Zhao

DexSynRefine: Synthesizing and Refining Human-Object Interaction Motion for Physically Feasible Dexterous Robot Actions Manipulation

dexterous manipulation human-object interaction motion synthesis residual reinforcement learning sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：一个灵巧操作框架，通过合成人-物交互运动参考并利用强化学习进行物理可行性优化，实现从仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: A framework for dexterous manipulation that synthesizes human-object interaction motion references and refines them with reinforcement learning for physically feasible sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation from human-object interaction (HOI) data is a scalable alternative to teleoperation, but HOI demonstrations are sparse and provide only kinematic motion that is not directly executable under embodiment mismatch and contact-rich dynamics. We present DexSynRefine, a framework with three coupled components: HOI-MMFP, a task- and object-initial-state-conditioned extension of motion manifold primitives that synthesizes coordinated hand-object trajectories from sparse HOI demonstrations; a task-space residual RL policy that physically grounds the synthesized reference while inheriting its kinematic structure; and a contact-and-dynamics adaptation module that enables sim-to-real transfer from proprioceptive history. Across five dexterous manipulation tasks spanning pick-and-place, tool use, and object reorientation, our task-space residual policy outperforms prior action-representation baselines in simulations and transfers to a real robot on all five tasks, improving over kinematic retargeting by 50-70 percentage points.

摘要（中文）：从人与物体交互（HOI）数据中学习灵巧操作是替代遥操作的一种可扩展方法，但HOI示范数据稀疏，且仅提供运动学轨迹，在实体形态差异及接触密集型动态环境下无法直接执行。本文提出DexSynRefine框架，该框架包含三个耦合组件：HOI-MMFP——一种基于任务和物体初始状态条件的运动流形基元扩展方法，可从稀疏HOI示范中生成协调的手-物体轨迹；任务空间残差强化学习策略——在继承合成参考轨迹运动学结构的同时实现物理落地；以及接触与动态适应模块——通过本体感知历史实现仿真到现实的迁移。在涵盖抓取放置、工具使用和物体重定向的五项灵巧操作任务中，我们的任务空间残差策略在仿真环境中优于先前的动作表示基准方法，并在全部五项任务中成功迁移至实体机器人，较运动学重定向方法提升50-70个百分点。

Authors: Hyesung Lee, Hyunwoo Jung, Si-Hwan Heo, Sungwook Yang

TriRelVLA: Triadic Relational Structure for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation VLA

triadic relational structure vision-language-action generalizable embodied manipulation relational graph relation-conditioned action generation

简要说明：本文提出了一个三元关系VLA框架，通过显式建模物体-手-任务关系原语，以提高具身操作任务的泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper proposes a triadic relational VLA framework that explicitly models object-hand-task relational primitives to improve generalization in embodied manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on training-seen robotic tasks but struggle to generalize to unseen scenes and objects. A key limitation lies in their implicit visual representations, which entangle object appearance, background, and scene layout. This makes policies sensitive to visual variations. Prior work improves transferability through structured intermediate representations that objectify visual content. However, these representations mainly capture scene semantics instead of action-relevant relations. As a result, action prediction remains tied to appearance statistics. We observe that manipulation actions depend on the object-hand-task relational structure, which governs interactions among task requirements, robot states, and object properties. Based on this observation, we propose TriRelVLA, a triadic relational VLA framework for generalizable embodied manipulation. Our approach consists of three components: 1) We construct explicit object-hand-task triadic representations from multimodal inputs as relational primitives. 2) We build a task-grounded relational graph. Task-guided cross-attention forms nodes, and a relation-aware graph transformer models interactions among them. 3) We perform relation-conditioned action generation. The relational structure is compressed into a bottleneck space and projected into the LLM for action prediction. This triadic relational bottleneck reduces reliance on appearance statistics and enables transfer across scenes, objects, and task compositions. We further introduce a real-world robotic dataset for fine-tuning. Experiments show strong performance on fine-tuned tasks and clear gains in cross-scene, cross-object, and cross-task generalization.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在训练中见过的机器人任务上表现良好，但在泛化到未见过的场景和物体时却面临困难。这一局限性的关键在于其隐式的视觉表征，这种表征往往将物体外观、背景与场景布局相互纠缠，导致策略对视觉变化高度敏感。先前的研究通过构建结构化的中间表征来对象化视觉内容，从而提升迁移能力。然而，这些表征主要捕捉的是场景语义，而非与动作相关的关联关系。因此，动作预测依然受限于外观统计特征。我们观察到，操控行为依赖于对象-手-任务三元关系结构，这种结构支配着任务需求、机器人状态与物体属性之间的相互作用。基于此观察，我们提出TriRelVLA，一个面向可泛化具身操控任务的三元关系式VLA框架。该框架包含三个核心部分：1）我们从多模态输入中构建显式的对象-手-任务三元表征作为关系基元；2）建立任务导向的关系图，通过任务引导的交叉注意力形成节点，并利用关系感知图变换器对节点间交互进行建模；3）执行基于关系条件的动作生成，将关系结构压缩至瓶颈空间，并投影到大型语言模型中用于动作预测。这种三元关系瓶颈机制减少了对外观统计特征的依赖，实现了跨场景、跨物体及跨任务组合的有效迁移。我们进一步引入了一个真实世界机器人数据集用于微调。实验结果表明，该方法在微调任务上表现出色，在跨场景、跨物体及跨任务泛化方面均取得显著提升。

Authors: Hanyu Zhou, Chuanhao Ma, Gim Hee Lee

Adaptive Q-Chunking for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning VLA

offline-to-online RL action chunking adaptive chunk size advantage selector robot manipulation

简要说明：提出自适应Q-Chunking（AQC），一种为离线到在线强化学习动态选择最优动作块长度的方法，以改善反应式控制和信用分配，在包括RoboCasa-GR1的机器人操作基准上展示了最先进的性能，并提升了VLA模型表现。

TLDR: Proposes Adaptive Q-Chunking (AQC), a method that dynamically selects optimal action-chunk horizons for offline-to-online RL to improve reactive control and credit assignment, demonstrating SOTA results on robot manipulation benchmarks including RoboCasa-GR1 with VLA models.

Abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning with action chunking eliminates multi-step off-policy bias and enables temporally coherent exploration, but all existing methods use a fixed chunk size across every state. This is suboptimal: near contact events the agent needs short chunks for reactive control, while during free-space motion long chunks provide better credit assignment. The natural solution is to train critics for several chunk sizes and select the best one at each state, but naive comparison of learned critic values systematically collapses to the shortest chunk due to discount-scale mismatch, and degrades to noise in low-value states. We propose Adaptive Q-Chunking (AQC), which resolves both failures by comparing the advantage of each chunk size relative to a per-horizon baseline, normalized by the discount factor. This criterion converts biased wrong answers into unbiased near-random choices when no genuine signal exists, and becomes discriminative when a particular scale enables better planning. We prove theoretical bounds on the advantage selector's noise immunity and on the value dominance of adaptive chunking over any fixed chunk size. We demonstrate that AQC achieves state-of-the-art offline and online success rates on OGBench and Robomimic, and can be applied to enhance the performance of large-scale VLA models that predict action sequences, significantly boosting performance on RoboCasa-GR1 tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 离线到在线强化学习结合动作分块消除了多步离策略偏差并实现了时间连贯性探索，但现有方法在所有状态中均采用固定分块尺寸。这种方案并非最优：在接触事件附近，智能体需要短分块实现反应式控制，而在自由空间运动中长分块能提供更优的信用分配。自然解决方案是为不同分块尺寸训练评价函数并在每个状态选择最优尺寸，但直接比较学习后的评价函数值会因折扣尺度失配而系统性坍缩至最短分块，在低价值状态中则退化为噪声选择。我们提出自适应Q分块方法（AQC），该方法通过比较各分块尺寸相对于对应时域基线的优势值（经折扣因子归一化处理），成功解决了这两类失效问题。该准则在无有效信号时将偏误错误答案转化为无偏近随机选择，当特定尺度能实现更优规划时则形成判别性选择。我们证明了优势选择器的抗噪性理论边界，以及自适应分块相较任意固定分块尺寸的价值主导性理论边界。实验表明，AQC在OGBench和Robomimic基准测试中达到了离线与在线成功率的最优水平，并可应用于增强预测动作序列的大规模视觉语言动作模型性能，在RoboCasa-GR1任务中实现显著性能提升。

Authors: Nandiraju Gireesh, Yuanliang Ju, He Wang

PRISM: Perception Reasoning Interleaved for Sequential Decision Making VLN

VLM-LLM framework closed-loop interaction goal-oriented perception sequential decision making embodied agents

简要说明：PRISM 提出了一种闭环 VLM-LLM 框架，用于具身智能体，通过 LLM 主动批判和查询 VLM 来优化图像描述，以支持任务驱动的序列决策。

TLDR: PRISM introduces a closed-loop VLM-LLM framework for embodied agents, where an LLM actively critiques and queries a VLM to refine image descriptions for task-driven sequential decision making.

Abstract: Scaling LLM-based embodied agents from text-only environments to complex multimodal settings remains a major challenge. Recent work identifies a perception-reasoning-decision gap in standalone Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which often overlook task-critical information. In this paper, we introduce PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline. Instead of passively accepting the VLM's description, the LLM critiques it, probes the VLM with goal-oriented questions, and synthesizes a compact image description. This closed-loop interaction yields a sharp, task-driven understanding of the scene. We evaluate PRISM on the ALFWorld and Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmarks. We show that: (1) PRISM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based models, (2) our Interactive goal-oriented perception pipeline yields systematic and substantial gains, and (3) PRISM is fully automatic, eliminating the need for handcrafted questions or answers.

摘要（中文）：将基于大语言模型（LLM）的具身智能体从纯文本环境扩展到复杂的多模态场景仍是一项重大挑战。近期研究指出，独立的视觉语言模型（VLM）存在感知-推理-决策的鸿沟，常常忽略任务关键信息。本文提出PRISM框架，通过动态问答（DQA）流程将感知（VLM）与决策（LLM）紧密耦合。LLM不再被动接受VLM的描述，而是对其进行批判性分析，向VLM提出目标导向的问题，并最终合成简明的图像描述。这种闭环交互能产生对场景的精准、任务驱动的理解。我们在ALFWorld和Room-to-Room（R2R）基准测试中评估PRISM，结果表明：（1）PRISM显著优于当前最先进的基于图像的模型；（2）我们提出的交互式目标导向感知流程带来系统性且显著的性能提升；（3）PRISM实现全自动化，无需人工设计问题或答案。

Authors: Mohamed Salim Aissi, Clemence Grislain, Clement Romac, Laure Soulier, Mohamed Chetouani, Olivier Sigaud, Nicolas Thome

Can Attribution Predict Risk? From Multi-View Attribution to Planning Risk Signals in End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

attribution planning risk end-to-end autonomous driving multi-view hierarchical attribution

简要说明：提出一种用于端到端自动驾驶模型的分层归因框架，提取的归因统计量与规划风险（如轨迹误差和碰撞）相关。

TLDR: Proposes a hierarchical attribution framework for end-to-end autonomous driving models, extracting attribution statistics that correlate with planning risk metrics like trajectory error and collisions.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving models generate future trajectories from multi-view inputs, improving system integration but introducing opaque decisions and hard-to-localize risks. Existing methods either rely on auxiliary monitoring models or generate textual explanations, but are decoupled from the planning process and fail to reveal the visual evidence underlying trajectory generation. While attribution offers a direct alternative, planning differs from image classification by taking six-view camera images as input and predicting continuous multi-step trajectories, requiring attribution to capture both critical views and regions and their influence on outputs. Moreover, whether attribution maps can support risk identification remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a hierarchical attribution framework for end-to-end planning. Specifically, using L2 consistency with the original trajectory as the objective, we design a coarse-to-fine region attribution strategy that searches candidate regions across the full six-view input and refines attribution within them. We further extract three attribution statistics as predictive signals for planning risk, including attribution entropy to measure how concentrated the planner's reliance is over the joint visual space, within-camera spatial variance to characterize how spread out the attribution is within each view, and cross-camera Gini coefficient to quantify how unevenly attribution is distributed across the six cameras. Experiments on BridgeAD, UniAD, and GenAD show that these statistics correlate with planning risk, achieving Spearman correlations of $0.30 \pm 0.07$ with trajectory error and AUROC of $0.77 \pm 0.04$ for collision detection. The signal generalizes to held-out scenes with negligible degradation and remains stable under an alternative attribution baseline.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶模型能够从多视角输入生成未来轨迹，虽提升了系统集成度，却引入了决策不透明与风险难以定位的问题。现有方法或依赖辅助监控模型，或生成文本解释，但均与规划过程解耦，未能揭示轨迹生成背后的视觉证据。尽管归因技术提供了直接替代方案，但规划任务与图像分类存在本质差异：它以六视角相机图像作为输入，预测连续的多步轨迹，要求归因方法既能捕捉关键视角与区域，又能揭示其对输出的影响。此外，归因图能否支持风险识别仍待探索。为此，我们提出一种面向端到端规划的分层归因框架。具体而言，以与原始轨迹的L2一致性为目标，设计了一种从粗到细的区域归因策略，该策略先在完整六视角输入中搜索候选区域，再对其进行精细化归因。我们进一步提取了三种归因统计量作为规划风险的预测信号：归因熵用于衡量规划器在联合视觉空间上依赖的集中程度，相机内空间方差用于刻画各视角内归因分布的离散程度，跨相机基尼系数则量化了归因在六台相机间分布的不均衡性。在BridgeAD、UniAD和GenAD数据集上的实验表明，这些统计量与规划风险具有相关性，与轨迹误差的斯皮尔曼相关系数达到$0.30 \pm 0.07$，碰撞检测的AUROC为$0.77 \pm 0.04$。该信号在未见过场景中仍能保持泛化能力且性能衰减可忽略，在替代归因基准下也保持稳定。

Authors: Le Yang, Ruoyu Chen, Haijun Liu, Jiawei Liang, ShangQuan Sun, Xiaochun Cao

Cross-Modal Navigation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning VLN

Cross-Modal Navigation Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Embodied Navigation Visual-Acoustic Navigation Modality Collaboration

简要说明：提出了一种用于跨模态导航的多智能体强化学习框架，其中轻量级模态专门化智能体利用辅助信念和集中式多模态批评器进行协作，在视听导航任务上表现出性能和效率的提升。

TLDR: Proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for cross-modal navigation, where lightweight modality-specialized agents collaborate using auxiliary beliefs and a centralized critic, showing improvements in performance and efficiency on visual-acoustic tasks.

Abstract: Robust embodied navigation relies on complementary sensory cues. However, high-quality and well-aligned multi-modal data is often difficult to obtain in practice. Training a monolithic model is also challenging as rich multi-modal inputs induce complex representations and substantially enlarge the policy space. Cross-modal collaboration among lightweight modality-specialized agents offers a scalable paradigm. It enables flexible deployment and parallel execution, while preserving the strength of each modality. In this paper, we propose \textbf{CRONA}, a Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) framework for \textbf{Cro}ss-Modal \textbf{Na}vigation. CRONA improves collaboration by leveraging control-relevant auxiliary beliefs and a centralized multi-modal critic with global state. Experiments on visual-acoustic navigation tasks show that multi-agent methods significantly improve performance and efficiency over single-agent baselines. We find that homogeneous collaboration with limited modalities is sufficient for short-range navigation under salient cues; heterogeneous collaboration among agents with complementary modalities is generally efficient and effective; and navigation in large, complex environments requires both richer multi-modal perception and increased model capacity.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 鲁棒的具身导航依赖于互补的感官线索。然而，在实际应用中，高质量且严格对齐的多模态数据往往难以获取。训练单一整体模型同样具有挑战性，因为丰富的多模态输入会引发复杂的表示形式，并显著扩大策略空间。轻量级、专长于特定模态的智能体之间的跨模态协作提供了一种可扩展的范式。它实现了灵活的部署和并行执行，同时保留了各模态的优势。本文提出了一种用于**跨模态导航**的多智能体强化学习框架，即**CRONA**。该框架通过利用与控制相关的辅助信念以及一个基于全局状态的集中式多模态评价器来增强协作。在视觉-听觉导航任务上的实验表明，多智能体方法相较于单智能体基线在性能与效率上均有显著提升。研究发现：在显著线索下，有限模态间的同质协作足以实现短距离导航；具有互补模态的智能体间的异质协作通常高效且有效；而在大规模、复杂环境中导航，则需要更丰富的多模态感知与更大的模型容量。

Authors: Shuo Liu, Xinzichen Li, Christopher Amato

ReActor: Reinforcement Learning for Physics-Aware Motion Retargeting Locomotion

reinforcement learning motion retargeting physics simulation bilevel optimization imitation learning

简要说明：提出一个双层优化框架，联合适应人类参考运动到机器人形态并使用强化学习训练跟踪策略，实现物理可行的运动重定向以促进模仿学习。

TLDR: Proposes a bilevel optimization framework that jointly adapts human reference motions to a robot's morphology and trains a tracking policy via RL, enabling physically plausible motion retargeting for imitation learning.

Abstract: Retargeting human kinematic reference motion onto a robot's morphology remains a formidable challenge. Existing methods often produce physical inconsistencies, such as foot sliding, self-collisions, or dynamically infeasible motions, which hinder downstream imitation learning. We propose a bilevel optimization framework that jointly adapts reference motions to a robot's morphology while training a tracking policy using reinforcement learning. To make the optimization tractable, we derive an approximate gradient for the upper-level loss. Our framework requires only a sparse set of semantic rigid-body correspondences and eliminates the need for manual tuning by identifying optimal values for a parameterization expressive enough to preserve characteristic motion across different embodiments. Moreover, by integrating retargeting directly with physics simulation, we produce physically plausible motions that facilitate robust imitation learning. We validate our method in simulation and on hardware, demonstrating challenging motions for morphologies that differ significantly from a human, including retargeting onto a quadruped.

摘要（中文）：摘要：将人类运动学参考动作重新映射到机器人的形态上，仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。现有方法通常会产生物理上不一致的现象，例如足部滑动、自碰撞或动力学不可行的动作，这阻碍了后续的模仿学习。我们提出了一种双层优化框架，在利用强化学习训练跟踪策略的同时，联合调整参考动作以适应机器人的形态。为使优化问题易于处理，我们推导了上层损失函数的近似梯度。该框架仅需稀疏的语义刚体对应关系，并通过识别参数化最优值来消除手动调整的需求，该参数化具有足够的表达能力，能够保留不同形态下的特征动作。此外，通过将重映射直接与物理模拟相结合，我们生成了物理上合理的动作，从而促进了鲁棒的模仿学习。我们通过仿真和硬件实验验证了所提方法，展示了即使在形态上与人类差异显著的机器人（包括四足机器人）上也能实现具有挑战性的重映射动作。

Authors: David Müller, Agon Serifi, Sammy Christen, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer

TouchDrive: Electronics-Free Tactile Sensing Interface for Assistive Grasping Manipulation

tactile sensing assistive grasping pneumatic feedback electronics-free passive mechanical loop

简要说明：TouchDrive 是一种用于辅助抓取的低成本、无电子器件的触觉传感接口，它通过一个被动的机械回路将接触力直接转换为气动反馈，实现了对易碎物体的精细操控。

TLDR: TouchDrive is a low-cost, electronics-free tactile interface for assistive grasping that converts contact forces directly into pneumatic feedback via a passive mechanical loop, enabling precise manipulation of delicate objects.

Abstract: Assistive robotic grasping plays an important role in enabling safe and adaptive manipulation of diverse objects. However, existing systems often rely on electronic sensing and multi-stage processing pipelines, increasing system complexity and reducing accessibility. To address these limitations, we present TouchDrive, a cost-effective, electronics-free tactile sensing interface for assistive grasping. TouchDrive directly converts contact forces into pneumatic feedback through valve-mediated switching, integrating sensing, signal generation, and feedback within a single passive mechanical loop. The system can be employed using a pneumatic normally closed valve, a compressed air tank, sensing element, and haptic feedback actuator without electronics. By delivering tactile cues, TouchDrive empowers users to modulate grasp forces, enabling precise and robust delicate manipulation of compliant and fragile objects. The interface has been validated across diverse robotic platforms, consistently demonstrating reliable performance and practical applicability in assistive grasping tasks, such as handling fruits and everyday items (up to 20 objects).

摘要（中文）：辅助机器人抓取技术对于实现多样化物体的安全与自适应操控至关重要。然而，现有系统通常依赖电子传感与多级处理流程，这增加了系统复杂性并降低了可及性。为突破这些局限，我们提出了TouchDrive——一种经济高效、无电子元件的触觉传感接口，专为辅助抓取而设计。TouchDrive通过阀控切换将接触力直接转化为气动反馈，将传感、信号生成与反馈集成于单一被动机械回路中。该系统仅需采用常闭气动阀、压缩气罐、传感元件及触觉反馈执行器即可实现，全程无需电子元件。通过传递触觉线索，TouchDrive使用户能够实时调节抓取力度，实现对柔性与易碎物体的精准稳健操控。该接口已在多种机器人平台上得到验证，在抓取水果及日常物品（最多达20种物体）等辅助任务中，持续展现出可靠性能与实际应用价值。

Authors: Jing Xu, Xuezhi Niu, Didem Gurdur Broo, Klas Hjort

AssistDLO: Assistive Teleoperation for Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Manipulation

teleoperation deformable linear object shared autonomy control barrier functions visual assistance

简要说明：AssistDLO 是一个用于柔性线状物体操作的辅助遥操作框架，结合了实时多视角状态估计、视觉辅助和基于控制屏障函数的几何感知共享自主控制器，并通过双手解结用户研究进行了评估。

TLDR: AssistDLO is an assistive teleoperation framework for deformable linear object manipulation that combines real-time multi-view state estimation, visual assistance, and a geometry-aware shared-autonomy controller based on Control Barrier Functions, evaluated in a bimanual knot-untangling user study.

Abstract: Manipulating Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is challenging in robotics due to their infinite-dimensional configuration space and complex nonlinear dynamics. In teleoperation, depth uncertainty hinders state perception and reaction. AssistDLO addresses this challenge as an assistive teleoperation framework for DLO manipulation that combines real-time multi-view state estimation, visual assistance (VA), and a geometry-aware shared-autonomy controller based on Control Barrier Functions (SA-CBF). While traditional shared autonomy methods often rely on simple geometric attractors and may fail to preserve DLO geometry, SA-CBF acts as a geometry-aware funnel, facilitating precise grasping while preserving the operator's high-level authority. The framework is evaluated in a bimanual knot-untangling user study (N = 22) using ropes with varying length and rigidity. Results show that the effectiveness of the assistance depends strongly on operator expertise and DLO properties. SA-CBF provides the strongest gains for naive users, acting as a skill equalizer that increases task success from 71% to 88%, and is effective for stiffer ropes. Conversely, expert users prefer VA, and highly compliant, long ropes benefit more from visual support than localized action assistance. Ultimately, these findings demonstrate that effective DLO teleoperation cannot rely on a fixed strategy, highlighting the critical need for adaptive, user-aware, and material-aware shared autonomy.

摘要（中文）：可变形线性物体（DLO）因其无限维构型空间和复杂的非线性动力学特性，在机器人操作中具有挑战性。遥操作中，深度不确定性会阻碍状态感知与实时响应。AssistDLO作为一种辅助遥操作框架，通过融合实时多视角状态估计、视觉辅助以及基于控制屏障函数的几何感知共享自主控制器，应对DLO操作中的这一难题。传统共享自主方法通常依赖简单几何吸引器，难以保持DLO的几何形态，而SA-CBF控制器则充当几何感知漏斗，在保障操作者高层决策权的同时实现精准抓取。本研究通过双手机器人解结实验（N=22），采用不同长度和刚度的绳索对框架进行评估。结果表明，辅助效果高度依赖于操作者经验与DLO特性：SA-CBF对新手的提升最显著，将任务成功率从71%提高至88%，起到技能均衡作用，且对较硬绳索效果突出；相反，专家用户更倾向视觉辅助，而对于高柔顺性长绳索，可视化支持比局部动作辅助更具优势。这些发现最终表明，有效的DLO遥操作不能依赖固定策略，亟需发展自适应、用户感知与材料感知的共享自主系统。

Authors: Berk Guler, Simon Manschitz, Kay Pompetzki, Jan Peters

Toward Visually Realistic Simulation: A Benchmark for Evaluating Robot Manipulation in Simulation Manipulation

sim-to-real physically-based rendering Multi-modal Large Language Models robot manipulation benchmark visual realism

简要说明：本文提出了VISER，一个用于机器人操作的视觉逼真仿真基准，包含一个高保真3D资产数据集和一个利用MLLM的自动化流程，以缩小仿真与现实的视觉差异。

TLDR: The paper proposes VISER, a visually realistic simulation benchmark for robot manipulation, featuring a high-fidelity 3D asset dataset and automated pipeline using MLLMs to bridge the sim-to-real visual gap.

Abstract: Reliable simulation evaluation of robot manipulation policies serves as a high-fidelity proxy for real-world performance. Although existing benchmarks cover a wide range of task categories, they lack visual realism, creating a large domain gap between simulation and reality. This undermines the reliability of simulation-based evaluation in predicting real-world performance. To mitigate the sim-to-real visual gap, we conduct a systematic analysis to isolate the effects of lighting and material. Our results show that these factors play a critical role in geometric reasoning and spatial grounding, yet are largely overlooked in existing benchmarks. Motivated by the analysis, we propose VISER, a visually realistic benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation in simulation. VISER features a high-fidelity dataset of over 1,000 3D assets with physically-based rendering (PBR) materials, along with 3D scenes created from these assets through curated layouts or generation. To this end, we propose an automated pipeline leveraging Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for material-aware part segmentation and material retrieval, enabling scalable generation of physically plausible assets. Building on the high-fidelity 3D asset dataset, we construct diverse evaluation tasks, such as grasping, placing, and long-horizon tasks, enabling scalable and reproducible assessment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. Our benchmark shows a strong correlation between simulation and real-world performance, achieving an average Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.92 across different policies.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作策略的可靠仿真评估可作为真实世界性能的高保真度代理。尽管现有基准测试覆盖了广泛的任务类别，但它们缺乏视觉真实感，导致仿真与现实之间存在显著的领域差异。这削弱了基于仿真的评估在预测真实世界性能方面的可靠性。为缩小仿真与现实的视觉差距，我们进行了系统分析以分离光照和材质因素的影响。结果表明，这些因素在几何推理和空间定位中起着关键作用，但在现有基准测试中大多被忽视。基于此分析，我们提出VISER——一个用于评估仿真中机器人操作的视觉真实基准测试。VISER包含超过1,000个基于物理渲染（PBR）材质的高保真度3D资产数据集，以及通过精心设计的布局或生成方法基于这些资产构建的3D场景。为此，我们提出了一种利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的自动化流程，实现材质感知的部件分割和材质检索，从而支持可扩展的物理合理资产生成。基于高保真度3D资产数据集，我们构建了多样化的评估任务（如抓取、放置和长时序任务），支持对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行可扩展且可复现的评估。我们的基准测试显示出仿真与真实世界性能之间的强相关性，在不同策略中平均皮尔逊相关系数达到0.92。

Authors: Yixin Zhu, Zixiong Wang, Jian Yang, Jin Xie, Jingyi Yu, Jiayuan Gu, Beibei Wang

When to Trust Imagination: Adaptive Action Execution for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models adaptive execution robotic manipulation future-reality verification action prediction

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人操作中世界行动模型自适应执行的方法，通过一个验证器决定何时信任想象的未来行动，从而提高了效率和鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for adaptive execution of World Action Models (WAMs) in robotic manipulation, using a verifier to decide when to trust the imagined future actions, improving efficiency and robustness.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly predicting future visual observations and future actions. However, current WAMs typically execute a fixed number of predicted actions after each model inference, leaving the robot blind to whether the imagined future remains consistent with the actual physical rollout. In this work, we formulate adaptive WAM execution as a future-reality verification problem: the robot should execute longer when the WAM-predicted future remains reliable, and replan earlier when reality deviates from imagination. To this end, we propose Future Forward Dynamics Causal Attention (FFDC), a lightweight verifier that jointly reasons over predicted future actions, predicted visual dynamics, real observations, and language instructions to estimate whether the remaining action rollout can still be trusted. FFDC enables adaptive action chunk sizes as an emergent consequence of prediction-observation consistency, preserving the efficiency of long-horizon execution while restoring responsiveness in contact-rich or difficult phases. We further introduce Mixture-of-Horizon Training to improve long-horizon trajectory coverage for adaptive execution. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark and in the real world demonstrate that our method achieves a strong robustness-efficiency trade-off: on RoboTwin, it reduces WAM forward passes by 69.10% and execution time by 34.02%, while improving success rate by 2.54% over the short-chunk baseline; in real-world experiments, it improves success rate by 35%.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）作为一种机器人操作的新范式，近年来展现出巨大潜力，通过联合预测未来视觉观测与未来动作来实现操作任务。然而，当前WAMs通常在每次模型推理后执行固定数量的预测动作，导致机器人无法判断想象中的未来是否与实际物理执行过程保持一致。本文提出将自适应WAM执行建模为未来-现实验证问题：当WAM预测的未来保持可靠时，机器人应延长执行时间；而当现实偏离想象时，则应提前重新规划。为此，我们提出未来前向动态因果注意力机制（FFDC），该轻量级验证器能够联合推理预测的未来动作、预测的视觉动态、实际观测以及语言指令，从而评估剩余动作序列是否仍可信任。FFDC通过预测-观测一致性实现了自适应动作块大小调整，在保持长时域执行效率的同时，增强了机器人在接触密集或复杂操作阶段的响应能力。我们还引入了混合时域训练方法，以提升自适应执行过程中的长时域轨迹覆盖能力。在RoboTwin基准测试和真实环境中的实验表明，该方法实现了鲁棒性与效率的显著平衡：在RoboTwin上，相比短时域基线方法，FFDC将WAM前向计算量减少69.10%，执行时间缩短34.02%，同时成功率提升2.54%；在真实世界实验中，成功率提升达35%。

Authors: Rui Wang, Yue Zhang, Jiehong Lin, Kuncheng Luo, Jianan Wang, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

EA-WM: Event-Aware Generative World Model with Structured Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields WorldModel

Generative World Model Video Diffusion Models Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields Event-Aware Fusion World-Action Models

简要说明：EA-WM提出了一种事件感知生成世界模型，将运动学动作映射为视觉动作场，以提升机器人视频预测中空间几何和交互动态的保真度。

TLDR: EA-WM introduces an Event-Aware Generative World Model that projects kinematic actions into visual action fields to improve the geometric and dynamic fidelity of generated robot rollouts in video prediction.

Abstract: Pretrained video diffusion models provide powerful spatiotemporal generative priors, making them a natural foundation for robotic world models. While recent world-action models jointly optimize future videos and actions, they predominantly treat video generation as an auxiliary representation for policy learning. Consequently, they insufficiently explore the inverse problem: leveraging action signals to guide video synthesis, thereby often failing to preserve precise robot spatial geometry and fine-grained robot-object interaction dynamics in the generated rollouts. To bridge this gap, we present EA-WM, an Event-Aware Generative World Model that effectively closes the loop between kinematic control and visual perception. Rather than injecting joint or end-effector actions as abstract, low-dimensional tokens, EA-WM projects actions and kinematic states directly into the target camera view as Structured Kinematic-to-Visual Action Fields. To fully exploit this geometrically grounded representation, we introduce event-aware bidirectional fusion blocks that modulate cross-branch attention, capturing object state changes and interaction dynamics. Evaluated on the comprehensive WorldArena benchmark, EA-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing baselines by a significant margin.

摘要（中文）：预训练视频扩散模型提供了强大的时空生成先验，使其成为机器人世界模型的天然基础。尽管近期的世界-动作模型联合优化未来视频与动作序列，但这些方法主要将视频生成视为策略学习的辅助表征手段。因此，它们未能充分探索逆向问题：如何利用动作信号引导视频合成，导致生成的推演轨迹往往难以保持精确的机器人空间几何关系以及细粒度的机器人与物体交互动力学。为填补这一空白，我们提出EA-WM（事件感知生成世界模型），该模型有效闭合了运动控制与视觉感知之间的回路。区别于将关节或末端执行器动作作为抽象低维标记注入的方法，EA-WM将动作与运动学状态直接投影至目标相机视角，形成结构化运动学-视觉动作场。为充分挖掘这种几何基础表征的潜力，我们设计了事件感知双向融合模块，通过跨分支注意力调制机制捕捉物体状态变化与交互动态。在综合性WorldArena基准测试中，EA-WM实现了最先进的性能，显著超越现有基线方法。

Authors: Zhaoyang Yang, Yurun Jin, Lizhe Qi, Cong Huang, Kai Chen

Adding Thermal Awareness to Visual Systems in Real-Time via Distilled Diffusion Models AutonomousDriving

image fusion diffusion models real-time perception autonomous driving infrared imaging

简要说明：提出FusionProxy，一个利用蒸馏扩散模型进行实时即插即用图像融合的模块，将红外信息集成到RGB视觉中，以增强全天候自动驾驶的鲁棒性。

TLDR: Proposes FusionProxy, a real-time plug-and-play image fusion module using distilled diffusion models to integrate infrared information into RGB vision, enhancing robustness for all-day autonomous driving.

Abstract: Purely RGB-based vision models often fail to provide reliable cues in challenging scenarios such as nighttime and fog, leading to degraded performance and safety risks. Infrared imaging captures heat-emitting sources and provides critical complementary information, but existing high-fidelity fusion methods suffer from prohibitive latency, rendering them impractical for real-time edge deployment. To address this, we propose FusionProxy, a real-time image fusion module designed as a fully independent, plug-and-play component with diffusion level quality. FusionProxy exploits two complementary statistics of a teacher sample ensemble: per-pixel variance in raw image space, used to weight pixel-level supervision, and per-pixel variance inside frozen foundation backbones, used to route feature-level alignment spatially. Once trained, FusionProxy can be directly integrated into any visual perception system without joint optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance on static recognition tasks and significantly enhances robustness in dynamic tasks, including closed-loop autonomous driving. Crucially, FusionProxy achieves real-time inference speeds on diverse platforms, from high-end GPUs to commodity hardware, providing a flexible and generalizable solution for all-day perception.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于纯RGB的视觉模型在夜间、雾天等复杂场景中往往难以提供可靠线索，导致性能下降与安全隐患。红外成像能够捕捉热辐射源并提供关键互补信息，但现有高保真融合方法存在过高延迟，难以应用于实时边缘部署。为此，我们提出FusionProxy——一种具备扩散级质量的实时图像融合模块，其设计为完全独立的即插即用组件。FusionProxy利用教师样本集合的两类互补统计量：原始图像空间中逐像素方差用于加权像素级监督，冻结基础骨干网络内的逐像素方差则用于空间特征级对齐路由。训练完成后，FusionProxy无需联合优化即可直接集成至任意视觉感知系统。大量实验表明，本方法在静态识别任务中达到优异性能，并显著增强动态任务（包括闭环自动驾驶）的鲁棒性。关键在于，FusionProxy在从高端GPU到商用硬件的多种平台上均可实现实时推理速度，为全天候感知提供了灵活且可泛化的解决方案。

Authors: Yuchen Guo, Junli Gong, Wenjun Dong, Yiuming Cheung, Weifeng Su

Multi-Robot Coordination in V2X Environments HumanoidEmbodied

V2X multi-robot coordination cooperative awareness humanoid robot quadrupedal robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于城市交通中分散式多机器人协同的V2X通信框架，包含两个以机器人为中心的服务，并通过人形机器人和四足机器人进行了真实场景演示。

TLDR: This paper introduces a V2X communication framework for decentralized multi-robot coordination in urban traffic, with two robot-centric services and a real-world demonstration using a humanoid and a quadrupedal robot.

Abstract: This paper presents a Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication framework that enables decentralized cooperation among social robots operating in complex urban traffic environments. Building on ETSI Cooperative Awareness and Maneuver Coordination services, the framework introduces two robot-centric facility-layer services: the Robot Awareness Service (RAS) and the Robot Maneuver Coordination Service (RMCS), realized through the Robot Awareness Message (RAM) and the Robot Maneuver Coordination Message (RMCM), respectively. RAS enables role-aware, task-oriented robot awareness while integrating externally detected Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs), including non-V2X pedestrians, into cooperative awareness. RMCS supports event-driven, low-latency coordination of robot maneuvers under explicitly established roles, without centralized infrastructure or prior pairing. A real-world proof of concept demonstrates deterministic multi-robot coordination between a humanoid robot and a quadrupedal robot assisting a pedestrian during a road-crossing scenario, governed by a formally specified finite-state coordination model. Complementary simulations evaluate robot-mediated VRU clustering in mixed V2X environments, showing that RAS-based clustering integrates non-V2X VRUs in safety-critical areas while reducing redundant transmissions from V2X-enabled VRUs, thereby lowering channel load. Together, the proposed services provide a scalable and standards-aligned foundation for integrating cooperative robots into future Connected, Cooperative, and Automated Mobility ecosystems.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种车联网（V2X）通信框架，可实现复杂城市交通环境中社会机器人的去中心化协作。该框架基于ETSI协同感知与机动协调服务，引入两种以机器人为核心的设施层服务：机器人感知服务（RAS）和机器人机动协调服务（RMCS），分别通过机器人感知消息（RAM）和机器人机动协调消息（RMCM）实现。RAS在实现角色感知、任务导向的机器人感知的同时，将外部检测到的弱势道路使用者（包括非V2X行人）纳入协同感知体系。RMCS支持在明确建立角色的前提下，以事件驱动、低延迟的方式协调机器人机动行为，无需中央基础设施或预先配对。通过现实场景的概念验证，在行人过马路情境中，由人形机器人与四足机器人依据形式化定义的有限状态协调模型，实现了确定性的多机器人协作。补充仿真实验评估了混合V2X环境中机器人介导的弱势道路使用者集群行为，表明基于RAS的集群机制能在安全关键区域整合非V2X弱势道路使用者，同时减少配备V2X设备的弱势道路使用者的冗余传输，从而降低信道负载。所提出的服务共同为将协作机器人融入未来网联化、协同化、自动化出行生态系统提供了可扩展且符合标准的基础框架。

Authors: John Pravin Arockiasamy, Alexey Vinel

GA3T: A Ground-Aerial Terrain Traversability Dataset for Heterogeneous Robot Teams in Unstructured Environments Perception3D

multi-robot collaborative perception cross-view perception heterogeneous robot teams terrain traversability unstructured environments

简要说明：提出了一个用于非结构化环境中空地异构机器人团队的真实世界协作感知数据集，包含同步的多模态、多视角数据，支持跨视角感知和可通行性分析。

TLDR: Presents a real-world multi-robot collaborative perception dataset for ground-aerial heterogeneous teams in unstructured terrain, featuring synchronized multi-modal and multi-view data for cross-view perception and traversability analysis.

Abstract: Heterogeneous air-ground robot teams combine complementary sensing modalities, mobility characteristics, and spatial viewpoints that can significantly enhance perception in complex outdoor environments. However, progress in multi-robot collaborative perception has been constrained by the lack of real-world datasets featuring overlapping multi-modal observations from platforms operating in unstructured terrain. We present GA3T (Ground-Aerial Team for Terrain Traversal), a real-world multi-robot collaborative perception dataset collected using a Clearpath Husky UGV and an Autel EVO~II UAV across diverse unstructured environments, including forest trails, rocky paths, muddy terrain, snow piles, and grass-covered fields. The ground platform provides 3D LiDAR, stereo camera, IMU, and GPS data, while the aerial platform contributes RGB imagery, thermal/infrared observations, and GPS from a complementary overhead viewpoint, allowing for rich cross-modal and cross-view perception. The dataset is collected in 4 unique environments, with over 13,000 synchronized frames across approximately 29 minutes of operation, and includes both SAM~3-based zero-shot segmentation and over 8,000 manually labeled images. A unique aspect of the dataset is its early-spring collection period, during which sparse tree canopies allow the aerial robot to partially observe the ground robot and terrain through the trees, allowing for occlusion-aware collaborative perception. Unlike prior multi-robot datasets that focus on SLAM or simulated cooperative driving, GA3T is specifically designed to support research on cross-view perception, air-ground viewpoint fusion, traversability estimation, and collaborative scene understanding in real off-road environments.

摘要（中文）：异构空地机器人团队融合了互补的感知模态、运动特性与空间视角，能够显著增强复杂户外环境中的感知能力。然而，由于缺乏在非结构化地形中运行的平台所产生的重叠多模态观测数据，多机器人协同感知研究的发展受到限制。本研究提出GA3T（地形穿越空地协同机器人数据集），这是一个真实世界的多机器人协同感知数据集，通过Clearpath Husky地面无人车与Autel EVO~II无人机在多种非结构化环境（包括森林小径、岩石路径、泥泞地形、雪堆及草地）中采集得到。地面平台提供三维激光雷达、双目相机、惯性测量单元与GPS数据，空中平台则从互补的俯视视角提供RGB图像、热红外观测及GPS数据，实现了丰富的跨模态与跨视角感知。该数据集涵盖4种独特环境，在约29分钟的运行时间内采集超过13,000帧同步数据，既包含基于SAM~3的零样本分割数据，也包含超过8,000张人工标注图像。数据集的独特之处在于其采集时间为早春时节，稀疏的树冠使空中机器人能够穿透林木部分观测地面机器人及地形，从而支持考虑遮挡的协同感知研究。与以往侧重于SLAM或模拟协同驾驶的多机器人数据集不同，GA3T专门设计用于支持真实越野环境中的跨视角感知、空地视角融合、可通行性估计及协同场景理解等研究方向。

Authors: Siwei Cai, Knut Peterson, Quan Tran, Christian Ricks, Dhanush Parthasarathy, Amir Kaidarov, Neil Deshpande, Sukaina Najm, David Han, Lifeng Zhou

Monitoring autonomous persistent surveillance missions using invariance Other

runtime monitoring persistent surveillance autonomous robots hybrid system invariant sets

简要说明：提出了一种用于在黑盒自主机器人执行持续监视任务时进行运行时监测的组合方法，该方法在分区环境中使用分散的不变集。

TLDR: Proposes a compositional runtime monitoring method for black-box autonomous robots performing persistent surveillance in partitioned environments, using decentralized invariant sets.

Abstract: This paper studies runtime monitoring for persistent surveillance by autonomous robots when the autonomy stack is a black box. The environment is partitioned into finitely many parts, each carrying an uncertainty state that decreases when observed and increases otherwise. We model the closed loop as a state-dependent hybrid system with linear parameter varying dynamics and design a monitor based on an invariant computed offline. As this invariant is typically hard to obtain for large to-be-surveyed spaces, we propose a compositional monitor obtained by decentralized computation of low-dimensional invariant sets for each uncertainty region, and checking their conjunction online. Under common independence assumptions, the compositional monitor is sound and complete with respect to the full-system invariant. The approach is applied in a case study with a real robot persistently monitoring a labyrinth, emphasizing its applicability in practice.

摘要（中文）：本文研究在自主机器人自主系统为黑盒条件下的持续监视运行时监控问题。环境被划分为有限多个区域，每个区域具有不确定状态，该状态在被观察时降低，反之则升高。我们将闭环系统建模为具有线性参数变化动态的状态依赖混合系统，并基于离线计算的不变式设计监控器。针对大规模待监测区域中不变式难以获取的问题，提出一种通过分散计算各不确定区域低维不变集，并在线验证其联合状态的组合式监控器。在常见的独立性假设下，该组合监控器相对于全系统不变式具有完备性和可靠性。通过真实机器人在迷宫环境中进行持续监视的案例研究，验证了该方法在实际应用中的可行性。

Authors: Vladislav Nenchev, Prodromos Sotiriadis

Plug-and-Play Label Map Diffusion for Universal Goal-Oriented Navigation VLN

Goal-Oriented Navigation Bird's-Eye-View Map Map Completion Diffusion Model Semantic Labeling

简要说明：提出了PLMD，一种基于扩散的模型，用于补全未观测区域的障碍物和语义标签地图，从而提升目标定位能力，并在目标导向导航任务中实现了最先进的性能。

TLDR: Proposes PLMD, a diffusion-based model that completes obstacle and semantic label maps for unobserved regions, enabling improved goal localization and state-of-the-art performance in Goal-Oriented Navigation.

Abstract: In embodied vision, Goal-Oriented Navigation (GON) requires robots to locate a specific goal within an unexplored environment. The primary challenge of GON arises from the need to construct a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) map to understand the environment while simultaneously localizing an unobserved goal. Existing map-based methods typically employ self-centered semantic maps, often facing challenges such as reliance on complete maps or inconsistent semantic association. To this end, we propose Plug-and-Play Label Map Diffusion (PLMD), which defines a novel map completion diffusion model based on Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM). PLMD generates obstacle and semantic labels for unobserved regions through a diffusion-based completion process, thereby enabling goal localization even in partially observed environments. Moreover, it mitigates inconsistent semantic association by leveraging structural consistency between known and unknown obstacle layouts and integrating obstacle priors into the semantic denoising process. By substituting predicted labels for unobserved regions, robots can accurately localize the specified objects. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PLMD \textbf{(I)} effectively expands the region of unknown maps, \textbf{(II)} integrates seamlessly into existing navigation strategies that rely on semantic maps, \textbf{(III)} achieves state-of-the-art performance on three GON tasks.

摘要（中文）：在具身视觉领域中，目标导向导航要求机器人在未知环境中定位特定目标。该任务的主要挑战在于需要构建鸟瞰图地图以理解环境，同时定位未被观测的目标。现有的基于地图的方法通常采用以自身为中心的语义地图，常面临依赖完整地图或语义关联不一致等问题。为此，我们提出即插即用标签地图扩散模型，该模型基于去噪扩散概率模型定义了一种新型地图补全扩散模型。通过基于扩散的补全过程，该模型能够生成未观测区域的障碍物与语义标签，从而在部分观测环境中实现目标定位。此外，该方法利用已知与未知障碍物布局之间的结构一致性，并将障碍物先验信息融入语义去噪过程，从而缓解了语义关联不一致的问题。通过用预测标签替代未观测区域，机器人能够准确锁定指定对象。大量实验表明，该模型具备以下优势：**（一）** 有效拓展未知地图区域，**（二）** 可无缝集成至现有依赖语义地图的导航策略中，**（三）** 在三种目标导向导航任务中均达到最先进的性能水平。

Authors: Zhixuan Shen, Yijie Zeng, Shengxiang Luo, Tianrui Li, Haonan Luo

Generating Roadside LiDAR Datasets from Vehicle-Side Datasets via Novel View Synthesis AutonomousDriving

LiDAR novel view synthesis roadside perception 3D object detection dataset generation V2X

简要说明：本文提出一个数据合成框架，通过激光雷达新视角合成技术，从车辆端数据生成带标注的路侧激光雷达数据集，以解决智能交通系统中路侧感知数据稀缺的问题。

TLDR: This paper proposes a data synthesis framework that generates labeled roadside LiDAR datasets from vehicle-side LiDAR data via novel view synthesis to address the scarcity of annotated roadside data for roadside perception in ITS.

Abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) require reliable environmental perception to support safe and efficient transportation. With the rapid development of Vehicle-to-everything (V2X), roadside perception has become an effective means to extend sensing coverage and improve traffic safety. However, the scarcity of large-scale annotated roadside LiDAR datasets poses a major challenge for training high-performance roadside perception models. In this paper, we introduce Vehicle-to-Roadside LiDAR Synthesis (VRS), a data synthesis framework that generates labeled roadside LiDAR datasets from vehicle-side datasets via LiDAR novel view synthesis. To mitigate the vehicle-to-roadside domain gap, VRS employs vehicle point cloud completion to compensate for missing geometry in vehicle-side observations, and introduces an occupancy-based visibility constraint to handle large viewpoint changes during cross-view rendering. The proposed framework enables flexible multi-view rendering for scalable roadside data generation. Extensive experiments on roadside 3D object detection demonstrate that the synthesized data effectively complements real roadside data, mitigates the limitations of limited real-world roadside data, and improves generalization to unseen roadside viewpoints.

摘要（中文）：智能交通系统需要可靠的环境感知能力以支持安全高效的交通运行。随着车路协同技术的快速发展，路侧感知已成为扩展感知范围与提升交通安全的重要手段。然而，大规模标注路侧激光雷达数据集的稀缺性对训练高性能路侧感知模型构成了主要挑战。本文提出车端到路侧激光雷达合成框架，该数据合成框架通过激光雷达新视角合成技术，能够从车端数据集生成带标注的路侧激光雷达数据集。为缩小车端与路侧之间的领域差异，本框架采用车辆点云补全技术以弥补车端观测中缺失的几何信息，并引入基于占据率的可见性约束来处理跨视角渲染过程中巨大的视点变化。所提出的框架支持灵活的多视角渲染，实现可扩展的路侧数据生成。在路侧三维目标检测任务上的大量实验表明，合成数据能有效补充真实路侧数据，缓解真实路侧数据有限带来的局限性，并提升对未知路侧视角的泛化能力。

Authors: Yuhan Xia, Runxin Zhao, Hanyang Zhuang, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

On the Emergence of Pendular Structure in Multi-Contact Locomotion Locomotion

legged locomotion centroidal OCP pendular force pattern angular momentum friction cone

简要说明：本文分析了腿式步态的简单最优控制目标如何自然地导致摆动力模式，将经典的ZMP/DCM模型与基于优化的控制器联系起来。理论结果在点质量四足机器人和Unitree Go1的仿真中得到了验证。

TLDR: This paper analyzes how simple optimal control objectives for legged locomotion naturally lead to pendular force patterns, connecting classical ZMP/DCM models to optimization-based controllers. The theoretical results are validated in simulation on a point-mass quadruped and the Unitree Go1 robot.

Abstract: LIPM is everywhere in legged-locomotion control, but almost always as a modeling choice rather than as something the controller's cost actually prefers. This note tries to make that link more explicit. Working from a small centroidal OCP that penalizes the rate of angular momentum, we look at what its optimum tends to look like. Three things come out. With full-rank stance, the optimum drifts toward a pendular force pattern at a rate determined by the SVD of the moment Jacobian; the constant is set by foot-span geometry and matches the experiments to within 16%. With N=2 stance, as in trot, the friction cone introduces a lower bound on $\|\dot{H}_G\|$ that no amount of weight tuning fixes; we also see a non-smooth feasibility kink at a critical horizontal acceleration that we can write in closed form. Adding a task term that asks for a nonzero $\dot{H}_G$ moves the optimum off the pendular set in a predictable way. None of this is far from the classical ZMP/DCM picture. We test these claims on a point-mass quadruped and on the Unitree Go1 in MuJoCo (open-loop QP and a torque-level closed-loop controller), and we note where the asymptotic story stops being a good description of what the closed loop actually does.

摘要（中文）：LIPM（线性倒立摆模型）在腿式运动控制中无处不在，但几乎总是作为建模选择出现，而非控制器成本函数真正倾向的对象。本文试图更明确地建立这一联系。基于一个惩罚角动量变化率的小型质心最优控制问题，我们观察其最优解的趋势。主要发现有三点：在足端满秩支撑情况下，最优解以力矩雅可比矩阵奇异值分解决定的速率向摆动力模式漂移；该常数由足部跨度几何设定，与实验数据误差在16%以内。在双足支撑（如小跑步态）下，摩擦锥为$\|\dot{H}_G\|$引入了下界，该下界无法通过权重调整消除；同时我们在临界水平加速度处观察到非光滑的可行性拐点，该拐点可用闭式表达。添加要求非零$\dot{H}_G$的任务项后，最优解以可预测方式偏离摆动力集。这些结论均未远离经典的ZMP/DCM理论框架。我们在点质量四足机器人和MuJoCo中的Unitree Go1机器人上验证了这些结论（分别采用开环二次规划控制和力矩级闭环控制），并指出了渐近理论在描述闭环实际行为时的局限性边界。

Authors: Lingxue Lyu, Zihui Liu

Contact-Free Grasp Stability Prediction with In-Hand Time-of-Flight Sensors Manipulation

grasp stability prediction time-of-flight sensors contact-free robotic grasping in-hand sensing

简要说明：本文提出了一种使用夹爪内飞行时间传感器的非接触式抓取稳定性预测器，能够在无需接触物体的情况下以15 Hz频率进行快速的预抓取稳定性分类。

TLDR: This paper proposes a contact-free grasp stability predictor using in-hand time-of-flight sensors, enabling fast pre-grasp stability classification at 15 Hz without requiring object contact.

Abstract: Current approaches to grasp planning for robotics demonstrate high success rates, but degrade with noisy sensors and other factors. Previous works have proposed tactile-based grasp stability classifiers to detect failures, but these approaches rely on making contact and grasping the object to do so. We propose a contact-free grasp stability predictor using multi-zone time-of-flight sensors mounted in the distal links of a gripper. Our method, as it does not require grasping the object to make a prediction, significantly speeds up the stability classification process, cycling at 15 Hz. We collected over 2,500 real-world grasps across 15 objects to train a classifier. Additionally, we conducted grasp attempts over six additional unseen objects, three for validation and model selection, and three for model testing. Our approach demonstrated strong classification performance, with an accuracy of 85.5% on validation and 86.0% on test objects.

摘要（中文）：当前的机器人抓取规划方法展现出高成功率，但在传感器噪声等因素影响下性能会下降。先前研究提出了基于触觉的抓取稳定性分类器来检测抓取失败，但这些方法需要实际接触并抓取物体才能进行判断。我们提出了一种无需接触的抓取稳定性预测器，通过在夹持器末端连杆上安装多区域飞行时间传感器实现。该方法无需抓取物体即可进行预测，从而将稳定性分类速度提升至15赫兹的循环频率。我们通过15种物体采集了超过2500次真实抓取数据来训练分类器。此外，我们还对六个未见过的物体进行了抓取测试，其中三个用于验证和模型选择，三个用于模型测试。实验结果显示该方法具有出色的分类性能，在验证集和测试集上分别达到85.5%和86.0%的准确率。

Authors: Kyle DuFrene, Cindy Grimm

Creative Robot Tool Use by Counterfactual Reasoning Manipulation

causal reasoning robot tool use VLM-based feature counterfactual tool generation skill keypoint transfer

简要说明：提出了一个用于创造性机器人工具使用的因果推理框架，通过在动力学模型中利用VLM特征建议和反事实工具生成来识别和基于物理基础转移工具使用技能。

TLDR: Proposes a causal reasoning framework for creative robot tool use, using VLM-based feature suggestion and counterfactual tool generation in a dynamics model to identify and transfer tool-use skills based on physical grounding.

Abstract: We propose a causal reasoning framework for creative robot tool use where a suitable tool for a task is correctly identified for use beyond its primary objectives. The proposed framework first discovers the causal relationships between the tool and the task by conducting simulated experiments in a dynamics model. We decouple the causal discovery problem into two complementary components: VLM-based feature suggestion and counterfactual tool generation via targeted geometric and physical feature perturbations. Then, novel objects are classified based on identified causal features, and the tool use skill is transferred via keypoint matching conditioned on the identified causal features. By reconstructing the task in a dynamics model, our approach grounds tool use in the physics of the problem. We illustrate our approach in reaching a distant object with different sticks, scooping candies from a bowl using diverse items, and using different boxes or crates as stepping platforms to retrieve an object from a high shelf. Our baseline comparisons show that identifying causal features and grounding them in physical tool properties leads to more reliable tool selection and stronger skill keypoint transfer.

摘要（中文）：本文提出一种用于创造性机器人工具使用的因果推理框架，该框架能够准确识别适用于特定任务的工具，并支持超越工具原始设计目标的使用场景。该框架首先通过动力学模型中的仿真实验，揭示工具与任务之间的因果关系。我们将因果发现问题解耦为两个互补模块：基于视觉语言模型的特征建议模块，以及通过针对性几何与物理特征扰动实现的因果反事实工具生成模块。随后基于识别出的因果特征对新物体进行分类，并通过以因果特征为条件的关键点匹配实现工具使用技能的迁移。通过动力学模型中的任务重构，本方法将工具使用建立在问题物理本质的基础上。我们在三类场景中验证了该框架：使用不同棍棒获取远处物体、利用多样物品从碗中舀取糖果，以及选用不同盒子或板条箱作为踏脚平台以获取高架上的物体。基线对比实验表明，识别因果特征并将其映射至物理工具属性，能够实现更可靠的工具选择和更强的技能关键点迁移能力。

Authors: M. Tuluhan Akbulut, Varun Satheesh, Ahmed Jaafar, Alper Ahmetoglu, Shane Parr, Aditya Ganeshan, Shivam Vats, George Konidaris

Track A*: Fast Visibility-Aware Trajectory Planning for Active Target Tracking AutonomousDriving

trajectory planning active target tracking search-based planning visibility-aware CARLA

简要说明：Track A* 是一种用于主动目标跟踪的快速离线搜索式轨迹规划器，它采用分层有向无环图搜索和工程优化，在四维时空网格中生成高质量的可视性感知轨迹，并在CARLA驾驶仿真中进行了验证。

TLDR: Track A* is a fast offline search-based trajectory planner for active target tracking that uses a layered DAG search and engineering optimizations to generate high-quality visibility-aware trajectories in 4D spatio-temporal grids, with validation in CARLA driving simulations.

Abstract: Offline reference trajectories for active target tracking are needed both for building multi-modal tracking datasets and for benchmarking online tracking planners under repeatable conditions. We present Track A star (TA star), an offline search-based trajectory planner that targets the visibility-aware target tracking objective on a discretized four-dimensional spatio-temporal grid (x, y, z, t). TA star combines a layered Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) search with three engineering optimizations: cross-time obstacle distance caching against a Bounding Volume Hierarchy (BVH), per-layer beam pruning, and a configurable multi-ray visibility evaluator. TA star employs a beam-pruned heuristic search on this discrete graph to efficiently find high-quality tracking trajectories. While it trades strict theoretical optimality for practical scalability, our empirical results demonstrate robust, near-baseline visibility performance at a fraction of the computational cost. On a 1000-scenario stress test across eight CARLA Optimized maps, TA star converges on all scenarios and completes in 45 s using 32 workers; on a 248-scenario controlled comparison against an unoptimized priority-queue A star baseline (BinaryHeap implementation) under identical scenario inputs and a 5 x 10^6 expansion cap, TA star reduces mean planning time by 23.0x and worst-case planning time by 11.8x, while raising convergence from 56.9% to 100%. On the n=141 baseline-converged subset, TA star changes average visibility by only -0.15 percentage points (pp), with no scenario exceeding a 5 pp drop. We position TA star as a practical offline reference planner under these specific conditions, with limitations and failure cases discussed for environments such as Town07 dense vegetation.

摘要（中文）：离线主动目标跟踪参考轨迹对于构建多模态跟踪数据集以及在可重复条件下评估在线跟踪规划器至关重要。本文提出基于搜索的离线轨迹规划器Track A star（TA star），该规划器在离散化的四维时空网格（x, y, z, t）上以可见性感知的目标跟踪为目标。TA star结合了分层有向无环图（DAG）搜索与三项工程优化：基于包围体层次结构（BVH）的跨时空障碍物距离缓存、逐层波束剪枝以及可配置的多射线可见性评估器。TA star在该离散化图上采用启发式波束剪枝搜索，以高效生成高质量跟踪轨迹。虽然该方法以牺牲严格理论最优性为代价换取实际可扩展性，但实验结果表明，在计算成本大幅降低的情况下，其可见性性能接近基线且鲁棒性显著。在CARLA优化地图集的八张地图上进行1000个场景的压力测试中，TA star在所有场景中均成功收敛，使用32个工作进程时仅需45秒完成；在248个场景的对照实验中，与未优化的优先级队列A star基线（BinaryHeap实现）在相同输入场景和5×10^6扩展上限条件下相比，TA star将平均规划时间缩短23.0倍，最坏情况规划时间缩短11.8倍，同时将收敛率从56.9%提升至100%。在基线可收敛的n=141场景子集中，TA star的平均可见性仅降低0.15个百分点，且所有场景的可见性下降均未超过5个百分点。我们将TA star定位为特定条件下的实用离线参考规划器，并针对Town07密集植被等环境讨论了其局限性及失效案例。

Authors: Hanxuan Chen, Kangli Wang, Ji Pei

NavOne: One-Step Global Planning for Vision-Language Navigation on Top-Down Maps VLN

Vision-Language Navigation global path planning top-down maps one-step planning end-to-end

简要说明：NavOne将视觉语言导航重新定义为一个在俯视地图上进行一步式全局路径规划的问题，实现了最先进的性能并显著提升了规划速度。

TLDR: NavOne reformulates Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) as a one-step global path planning problem on top-down maps, achieving state-of-the-art performance and significant planning speedups.

Abstract: Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods typically adopt an egocentric, step-by-step paradigm, which struggles with error accumulation and limits efficiency. While recent approaches attempt to leverage pre-built environment maps, they often rely on incrementally updating memory graphs or scoring discrete path proposals, which restricts continuous spatial reasoning and creates discrete bottlenecks. We propose Top-Down VLN (TD-VLN), reformulating navigation as a one-step global path planning problem on pre-built top-down maps, supported by our newly constructed R2R-TopDown dataset. To solve this, we introduce NavOne, a unified framework that directly predicts dense path probabilities over multi-modal maps in a single end-to-end forward pass. NavOne features a Top-Down Map Fuser for joint multi-modal map representation, and extends Attention Residuals for spatial-aware depth mixing. Extensive experiments on R2R-TopDown show that NavOne achieves state-of-the-art performance among map-based VLN methods, with a planning-stage speedup of 8x over existing map-based baselines and 80x over egocentric methods, enabling highly efficient global navigation.

摘要（中文）：现有的视觉语言导航（VLN）方法通常采用以自我为中心的逐步导航范式，这种方法易受误差累积影响且效率受限。近期研究虽尝试利用预先构建的环境地图，但大多依赖增量更新记忆图或对离散路径方案进行评分，这限制了连续空间推理能力并产生离散瓶颈。我们提出自上而下视觉语言导航（TD-VLN）方法，将导航任务重新定义为在预先构建的俯视地图上进行单步全局路径规划问题，并基于新构建的R2R-TopDown数据集提供支持。为此，我们引入NavOne统一框架，该框架能够通过单次端到端前向传播直接预测多模态地图上的密集路径概率。NavOne具备融合多模态地图表征的俯视地图融合器，并扩展了注意力残差机制以实现空间感知的深度混合。在R2R-TopDown数据集上的大量实验表明，NavOne在基于地图的VLN方法中实现了最优性能，其规划阶段速度较现有基于地图的基线方法提升8倍，较以自我为中心的方法提升80倍，为实现高效全局导航提供了可能。

Authors: Dijia Zhan, Jinyi Li, Chenxi Zheng, Shaoyu Huang, Yong Li, Jie Tang, Xuemiao Xu

HaM-World: Soft-Hamiltonian World Models with Selective Memory for Planning WorldModel

world models Hamiltonian dynamics Mamba memory model-based planning latent dynamics

简要说明：HaM-World 是一种结构化世界模型，将隐状态分解为典型 (q, p) 子空间和上下文子空间，并使用 Mamba 实现选择性记忆，以实现稳定的长程控制规划。

TLDR: HaM-World is a structured world model that decomposes latent state into canonical (q, p) and context subspaces, using Mamba for selective memory, to enable stable long-horizon planning for control.

Abstract: World models enable model-based planning through learned latent dynamics, but imagined rollouts become unstable as the planning horizon grows or the dynamics distribution shifts. We argue that this instability reflects two missing structures in planner-facing latents: history-conditioned memory for approximate Markov completeness, and geometric organization that separates configuration, momentum, and task semantics. We propose HaM-World (HMW), a structured world model that decomposes the latent state into a canonical (q, p) subspace and a context subspace c, while using Mamba selective state-space memory as the history-conditioned input to the same latent dynamics. Within this interface, (q, p) evolves through an energy-derived Hamiltonian vector field plus learnable residual/control dynamics, while c captures semantic, dissipative, and non-conservative factors. This gives the planner a single latent state shared by dynamics prediction, reward/value estimation, imagined rollouts, and CEM action search. On four DeepMind Control Suite tasks, HaM-World reaches the highest Avg. AUC (117.9, +9.5%), reduces long-horizon rollout error to 45% of a strong baseline model, and wins 11/12 k in {3,5,7} MSE cells. Under 12 OOD perturbations spanning dynamics shifts, action delay, and observation masking, HaM-World achieves the highest return in every condition, with average OOD-return gains of 10.2% on Finger Spin and 13.6% on Reacher Easy. Mechanism diagnostics further show bounded action-free Hamiltonian-energy drift, structured energy variation under policy rollouts, and coherent control-induced energy transfer, supporting the intended Soft-Hamiltonian dynamics design.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过学习隐式动力学实现基于模型的规划，但当规划视野扩大或动力学分布发生偏移时，仿真推演过程会变得不稳定。我们认为这种不稳定性源于规划导向的隐式表示中缺失两种结构：用于近似马尔可夫完备性的历史条件记忆机制，以及用于区分配置、动量和任务语义的几何组织形式。本文提出结构化世界模型HaM-World（HMW），该模型将隐式状态分解为规范子空间（q, p）与上下文子空间c，同时采用Mamba选择性状态空间记忆作为历史条件输入馈入同一隐式动力学系统。在此架构中，（q, p）通过能量导出的哈密顿向量场与可学习的残差/控制动力学进行演化，而c则捕捉语义、耗散与非守恒因素。该设计为规划器提供了统一的隐式状态接口，可同时服务于动力学预测、奖励/价值估计、仿真推演及交叉熵方法动作搜索。在DeepMind Control Suite的四个任务中，HaM-World取得了最高平均AUC指标（117.9，提升9.5%），将长视野推演误差降至基线模型的45%，并在{3,5,7}个MSE计算单元中赢得11/12的对比测试。在面对包含动力学偏移、动作延迟和观测遮蔽的12种分布外干扰时，HaM-World在所有条件下均取得最高回报，其中Finger Spin任务的平均分布外回报提升10.2%，Reacher Easy任务提升13.6%。机制诊断进一步显示：模型实现了有界的无动作哈密顿能量漂移、策略推演下的结构化能量变化以及连贯的控制诱导能量传递，验证了所设计的软哈密顿动力学机制的有效性。

Authors: Haoyun Tang, Haodong Cui, Keyao Xu, Kun Wang, Zhandong Mei

MobileEgo Anywhere: Open Infrastructure for long horizon egocentric data on commodity hardware VLA

egocentric data long horizon commodity hardware Vision Language Action dataset

简要说明：提出了MobileEgo Anywhere，一个利用商用移动硬件采集长时程第一人称数据的开放基础设施，包括数据集、移动应用和用于VLA模型训练的预处理流水线。

TLDR: Presents MobileEgo Anywhere, an open infrastructure for collecting long-horizon egocentric data using commodity mobile hardware, including a dataset, mobile app, and processing pipeline for VLA model training.

Abstract: The recent advancement of Vision Language Action (VLA) models has driven a critical demand for large scale egocentric datasets. However, existing datasets are often limited by short episode durations, typically spanning only a few minutes, which fails to capture the long horizon temporal dependencies necessary for complex robotic task execution. To bridge this gap, we present MobileEgo Anywhere, a framework designed to facilitate the collection of robust, hour plus egocentric trajectories using commodity mobile hardware. We leverage the ubiquitous sensor suites of modern smartphones to provide high fidelity, long term camera pose tracking, effectively removing the high hardware barriers associated with traditional robotics data collection. Our contributions are three fold: (1) we release a novel dataset comprising 200 hours of diverse, long form egocentric data with persistent state tracking; (2) we open source a mobile application that enables any user to record egocentric data, and (3) we provide a comprehensive processing pipeline to convert raw mobile captures into standardized, training ready formats for Vision Language Action model and foundation model research. By democratizing the data collection process, this work enables the massive scale acquisition of long horizon data across varied global environments, accelerating the development of generalizable robotic policies.

摘要（中文）：近期视觉语言行动（VLA）模型的发展对大规模第一人称视角数据集提出了迫切需求。然而，现有数据集往往受限于短片段时间跨度，通常仅持续数分钟，难以捕捉复杂机器人任务执行所需的长期时序依赖关系。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MobileEgo Anywhere框架，旨在利用商用移动硬件收集持续一小时以上的强鲁棒性第一人称轨迹数据。该框架借助现代智能手机的普及化传感器套件，提供高保真度、长期稳定的相机姿态跟踪，有效降低了传统机器人数据采集所需的高硬件门槛。我们的贡献包括三个方面：（1）发布包含200小时多样化长时程第一人称数据的新型数据集，其中包含持续性状态跟踪；（2）开源支持任意用户录制第一人称数据的移动应用程序；（3）提供完整的处理流程，可将原始移动端采集数据转换为适用于视觉语言行动模型及基础模型研究的标准化训练就绪格式。通过推动数据采集过程的大众化，本工作实现了在多样化全球环境中大规模获取长时程数据，加速了通用化机器人策略的开发进程。

Authors: Senthil Palanisamy, Abhishek Anand, Satpal Singh Rathor, Pratyush Patnaik, Shubhanshu Khatana

RobotEQ: Transitioning from Passive Intelligence to Active Intelligence in Embodied AI Other

active intelligence embodied AI social norms benchmark spatial grounding

简要说明：本文提出了RobotEQ基准，用于评估具身AI中的'主动智能'，即机器人无需明确指令即可理解并遵守社会规范，通过动作判断和空间定位任务进行评测。

TLDR: This paper introduces RobotEQ, a benchmark for assessing 'active intelligence' in embodied AI, where robots must understand and adhere to social norms without explicit instructions, through action judgment and spatial grounding tasks.

Abstract: Embodied AI is a prominent research topic in both academia and industry. Current research centers on completing tasks based on explicit user instructions. However, for robots to integrate into human society, they must understand which actions are permissible and which are prohibited, even without explicit commands. We refer to the user-guided AI as passive intelligence and the unguided AI as active intelligence. This paper introduces RobotEQ, the first benchmark for active intelligence, aiming to assess whether existing models can comprehend and adhere to social norms in embodied scenarios. First, we construct RobotEQ-Data, a dataset consisting of 1,900 egocentric images, spanning 10 representative embodied categories and 56 subcategories. Through extensive manual annotation, we provide 5,353 action judgment questions and 1,286 spatial grounding questions, specifying appropriate robot actions across diverse scenarios. Furthermore, we establish RobotEQ-Bench to evaluate the performance of state-of-the-art models on this task. Experimental results show that current models still fall short in achieving reliable active intelligence, particularly in spatial grounding. Meanwhile, we observe that leveraging RAG techniques to incorporate external social norm knowledge bases can generally enhance performance. This work can facilitate the transition of robotics from user-guided passive manipulation to active social compliance.

摘要（中文）：具身人工智能是学术界与工业界共同关注的前沿研究课题。当前研究主要集中于依据用户的显式指令完成任务。然而，要使机器人真正融入人类社会，它们必须理解哪些行为是被允许的、哪些是被禁止的，即便在没有明确指令的情况下。我们将用户引导的人工智能称为被动智能，将无引导的人工智能称为主动智能。本文提出了首个面向主动智能的基准测试RobotEQ，旨在评估现有模型能否在具身场景中理解并遵守社会规范。首先，我们构建了RobotEQ-Data数据集，该数据集包含1,900张以自我为中心视角的图像，涵盖10个代表性具身类别和56个子类别。通过大量人工标注，我们提供了5,353个行动判断问题和1,286个空间定位问题，明确了不同场景下机器人应采取的正确行为。此外，我们建立了RobotEQ-Bench基准，用于评估当前最先进模型在此任务上的表现。实验结果表明，现有模型在实现可靠的主动智能方面仍有不足，尤其在空间定位能力上存在明显短板。同时，我们发现利用RAG技术整合外部社会规范知识库，通常能提升模型性能。此项研究有望推动机器人技术从用户引导的被动操作向主动社会合规性迈进。

Query2Uncertainty: Robust Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration for 3D Object Detection under Distribution Shift Perception3D

3D object detection uncertainty quantification calibration distribution shift density estimation

简要说明：提出了一种面向3D目标检测不确定性的密度感知校准方法，利用潜在目标查询特征在分布偏移下改善校准性能。

TLDR: Introduces a density-aware calibration method for 3D object detection uncertainty, using latent object query features to improve calibration under distribution shifts.

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimation for 3D object detection is critical for deploying safe autonomous systems, yet modern detectors remain poorly calibrated, especially under distribution shifts. Although post-hoc calibration methods address this issue and provide improved calibration for in-distribution tests, they fail to adapt in distribution-shifted scenarios. In this work, we address this issue and introduce a density-aware calibration method that couples post-hoc calibrators with the feature density of latent object queries from DETR-style 3D object detectors. These queries form a compact, location and class-aware feature, ideal for density estimation, allowing our approach to adjust model confidences in distribution-shift scenarios. By fitting a density estimator on these query features, our approach jointly recalibrates both classification and bounding box regression uncertainties. On both a multi-view camera and LiDAR-based detector, our approach consistently outperforms standard post-hoc methods in both in-distribution and distribution-shifted scenarios. Code available https://tillbeemelmanns.github.io/query2uncertainty/ .

摘要（中文）：三维物体检测的可靠不确定性估计对于部署安全自动驾驶系统至关重要，然而现代检测器的校准效果依然欠佳，尤其在分布偏移的情况下。尽管事后校准方法能够改善这一问题，并在分布内测试中提供更好的校准效果，但它们无法适应分布偏移场景。本研究针对这一问题，提出了一种密度感知校准方法，该方法将事后校准器与基于DETR风格三维物体检测器中潜在物体查询的特征密度相结合。这些查询构成了紧凑且具有位置与类别感知的特征，非常适用于密度估计，从而使我们的方法能够在分布偏移场景中调整模型置信度。通过对这些查询特征拟合密度估计器，我们的方法能够同时重新校准分类和边界框回归的不确定性。在多视角相机和基于激光雷达的检测器上，我们的方法在分布内和分布偏移场景中均持续优于标准事后校准方法。代码已公开：https://tillbeemelmanns.github.io/query2uncertainty/。

Authors: Till Beemelmanns, Alexey Nekrasov, Stefan Vilceanu, Jonas Steinhaus, Timo Woopen, Bastian Leibe, Lutz Eckstein

Hitting Time Isomorphism for Multi-Stage Planning with Foundation Policies Locomotion

hitting time representation learning offline reinforcement learning multi-stage planning foundation policy

简要说明：提出了一种新的离线强化学习表示学习框架，通过命中时间学习有向时序几何，实现鲁棒的多阶段长视野导航规划。衍生的同构嵌入学习算法提升了从离线迷宫移动数据中学习基础策略的效果。

TLDR: Proposes a new representation learning framework for offline RL that learns a directed temporal geometry from hitting times, enabling robust multi-stage planning for long-horizon navigation. The derived Isomorphic Embedding Learning (IEL) algorithm improves foundation policy learning from offline maze locomotion data.

Abstract: We present a new operator-theoretic representation learning framework for offline reinforcement learning that recovers the directed temporal geometry of a controlled Markov process from hitting time observations. While prior art often produces symmetric distances or fails to satisfy the triangle inequality, our framework learns a Hilbert-space displacement geometry where expected hitting times are realized as linear functionals of latent displacements. We prove that this representation exists under latent linear closure and is uniquely identifiable up to a bounded linear isomorphism. For finite-dimensional implementations, we show that global hitting-time error is bounded by one-step transition error amplified by the environment's transient spectral radius. Furthermore, we provide finite-sample guarantees accounting for approximation, statistical complexity, and trajectory-label mismatch. Derived from this theory, we curate Isomorphic Embedding Learning (IEL) as a new goal-agnostic foundation policy learning algorithm that anchors a HILP-style consistency objective with explicit hitting-time regression to ensure that the learned geometry reflects actual decision-time progress. This asymmetric and compositional structure enables robust graph-based multi-stage planning for long-horizon navigation. Our experiments demonstrate that IEL improves the state of the art of learning foundation policy policies from offline maze locomotion data. Our code can be found on https://github.com/MagnusBoock/IEL

摘要（中文）：我们提出一种基于算子理论的离线强化学习表示学习框架，该框架通过命中时间观测数据重建受控马尔可夫过程的定向时间几何结构。现有方法通常仅能生成对称距离度量或无法满足三角不等式，而本框架能够学习希尔伯特空间中的位移几何结构，其中期望命中时间可表示为潜在位移的线性泛函。我们证明该表示在潜在线性闭包条件下存在，且在有界线性同构意义下具有唯一可辨识性。对于有限维实现，我们证明全局命中时间误差的边界由环境瞬态谱半径放大的一步转移误差所决定。此外，我们提供了综合考虑近似误差、统计复杂度与轨迹标签失配的有限样本保证。基于该理论，我们构建了同构嵌入学习算法作为一种新型目标无关的基础策略学习算法，该算法以HILP式一致性目标为基础，通过显式命中时间回归确保学习到的几何结构能反映实际决策过程的进展。这种非对称组合结构为长时程导航任务提供了鲁棒的基于图的多阶段规划能力。实验表明，在基于离线迷宫运动数据学习基础策略的任务中，同构嵌入学习算法取得了当前最优性能。代码已开源：https://github.com/MagnusBoock/IEL
